name: Media pin-screen
doc: The picture as a pin-screen toy in 3D (or a floating point cloud): one pin per cell of the image, its round head that cell's colour and its height the cell's brightness; kicks (the kick input, else onsets) shove every pin up, the bass lifts the field, a ring runs out from the centre each beat and the heads catch a palette rim light, seen along one of five camera paths (orbit, flyover, top-down, crane, spiral).

shape.doc: rods with round heads, or glowing points floating at their height

size.doc: head radius, share of a cell (points are about half that)

height.doc: height of a white pin, in cell widths

kick.doc: kick level (bind an envelope); onsets stand in when it is lower

punch.doc: how far a full kick shoves the pins up, in cell widths

wave.doc: height of the ring that runs out from the centre each beat

swing.doc: orbit: how far the camera swings around (radians)

spin.doc: orbit: steady turn, turns per minute x 10

glow.doc: palette rim light on the heads (with the beat)
